label: Seedance 2.0 multimodal video with native audio

prompt_contract.style: prose sentences in formula order; the template reads: subject does main action in setting, the image is visual style, the camera uses shot size and movement, sound includes dialogue ambience effects or music
notes: Keep a single clip's prompt to roughly sixty to a hundred words; instruction adherence decays with position, so priorities go first.
Verbs carry motion better than adjectives: a concrete action with a physical consequence reads more clearly than a stack of quality words.
One or two concrete attributes per subject; more dilutes the ones that matter.

camera_control.command_syntax: name one move in the camera sentence, optionally with its end state, for example a slow push-in from a 45 degree angle ending in a medium close-up
notes: One primary move per clip; stacked moves produce jitter and drift.
Sequential moves require an explicit cut marker rather than two moves inside one shot.

multi_shot_control.syntax: a timeline of beats, each beat naming its seconds, what is on screen, what the camera does, and its audio, for example 0-3s followed by the beat description

shot_budget.shots: a timeline is required rather than prose

notes: Audio cues belong inside their beat rather than collected at the end of the prompt.
Writing a long clip as one sentence causes character drift and camera wandering.

sweet_spots: up to 8s a single described shot
match scene complexity to duration; cramming locations into a short clip smears the result

audio_control.sound_syntax: name sounds inside the sound layer, or inside the beat that carries them; a settings toggle can disable audio generation entirely
audio_control.dialogue_syntax: state the language and delivery, then the line
audio_control.unspecified_behaviour: audio is generated in the same pass, so silence must be asked for explicitly
notes: Audio and video are produced together, which supports genuine lip sync.
Ask for no music by name when a beat should carry only ambience.

frame_control.resolution_parameter: resolution preset, allowed only with frame images and mutually exclusive with width and height
notes: Width and height are required whenever frame images are not supplied.
Every pair above, including the 4k tier, is in the host's parameter schema for this model.

input_modes.text_must_establish: world, character appearance, placement, state, camera, action, and landing

input_modes.limits: at most two, addressed as first and last
input_modes.text_must_establish: the path between them without creating a competing landing

input_modes.media_supplies: identity, wardrobe, or palette, according to the role the text assigns
input_modes.text_must_establish: each reference's explicit job, and everything the reference must not control

input_modes.media_supplies: motion, timing, camera, or an anchor shot's established look
input_modes.text_must_establish: what carries over from the source and what changes

input_modes.limits: up to three, and only alongside image or video references
input_modes.text_must_establish: who speaks, and how the audio relates to the visible action

anti_patterns: a reference supplied without a stated job, which lets its lighting and framing bleed into the result
more than one camera move in a single clip
eight or more requirements in one prompt, of which only some are honoured
a long clip written as one continuous sentence instead of a beat timeline
several locations crammed into a short duration
mixing prompt languages when on-screen text is wanted
leaving silence unstated when a beat should be quiet

constraints.geometry: width and height together, from the listed pairs, are required unless frame images are given; the resolution preset (480p, 720p, 1080p, 4k) is accepted only with frame images and is exclusive with width and height
constraints.text: positivePrompt of 2 to 10000 characters, required in every mode

frame_images.placement: at least one of them is not the last frame

reference_videos.input: an uploaded media id or a URL, not a data URI

reference_audios.requires: reference images or reference videos in the same request
reference_audios.input: an uploaded media id or a URL

constraints.frame_images_exclusive_with: reference images, reference videos and reference audios
constraints.seed: not in the schema: the service exposes no seed for this model
constraints.inputs_envelope: media keys sit inside an inputs object (inputs.referenceImages, inputs.frameImages, inputs.referenceVideos, inputs.referenceAudios)
